books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.notes: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems. Identity-based habits: every action is a vote for the person you want to become.

books.title: Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World
books.author: Cal Newport
books.notes: Shallow work feels productive because it is measurable. Depth produces results that compound quietly over years.

books.title: A Philosophy of Software Design
books.author: John Ousterhout
books.notes: Design it right the first time: fewer errors are better than fewer features. Comments should describe what is not obvious, not narrate the code.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.author: Andrew Hunt; David Thomas
books.notes: Your knowledge is a garden that grows stale unless you water it. Broken window theory applies to codebases and to teams.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.notes: The Agricultural Revolution was not a triumph for individual humans — the wheat domesticated us. Shared fictions let strangers cooperate at scale.

books.title: Clean Code
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.notes: A long function is a smell. Duplicated knowledge is the root of most maintenance pain. Duplicated du du du du du is a typo, not a book title.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.notes: System 1 is fast, automatic and confident. System 2 is lazy and expensive, so it accepts System 1's answer far more often than it should.

books.title: The Design of Everyday Things
books.author: Don Norman
books.notes: Good design is obvious when it works. Affordances and signifiers should make the correct action the easiest action.

books.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
books.author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
books.notes: Memory is circular and unreliable. Rainy April lasted only ten days, which is a plausible line to test against notes for typos.

books.title: The Mythical Man-Month
books.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
books.notes: Adding people to a late project makes it later. Communication paths grow quadratically with team size.

books.title: Meditations
books.author: Marcus Aurelius
books.notes: Edge case for the date validator: January 1 is the oldest record in the vault. 01/01 is not a valid entry format.

books.title: Flatland
books.author: Edwin Abbott
books.notes: Largest allowed page count (99,999). This pushes the vault over any small page target so the assertive target message can be demonstrated.
